absent: Name to bit parsing rules, full symbolic name list with bit positions, and initial value of the global default mask.
Generic string transfer semantics including length, offset and permission handling.
Register view helpers for stack pointer, instruction pointer, syscall number and argument extraction across architectures.
Reporters for timer list and filtered task state plus trace dump mode meanings and output formats.
Remaining decimal conversion failure expectations, signed decimal cases and self test registration trigger.
Concurrency effects on readers during concurrent writes beyond single access tolerance and lifetime of control memory.

findings.text: Public diagnostic routine accepts a caller selection and emits matching kernel reports, substituting the stored global default held in kernel_si_mask when the caller passes zero.

Public sampler fills a caller supplied record with stack location, instruction location, syscall number and six argument values for a target task, reporting a retryable failure when a remote target cannot be observed stably.

Shared control handler serves both read and write directions for a string control, preparing a freshly allocated scratch area sized from known symbolic names and delegating to direction specific logic with the original global pointer.
Early boot initializer registers the kernel namespaced info controls exactly once and unconditionally reports success.
Control table publishes a single selectable info node under the kernel hierarchy through the shared handler backed by the global mask store.

Each set bit in the effective selection independently triggers its own reporter, covering normal task listing, memory summary, timer listing, lock listing, trace dump, all CPU backtraces and uninterruptible task listing.

Scratch length is derived from the combined lengths of all known symbolic names plus separator allowance, installed with the fresh buffer into a mutable copy of the otherwise read only descriptor before delegation.
Write handling first delegates user text transfer to generic string logic and only after success converts the resulting text into a bit selection for single publication to the caller global.

Read handling snapshots the caller global once and renders only enabled entries with non empty names as comma separated text bounded by the supplied capacity before delegating user transfer to generic string logic.
Local collection treats inability to acquire the target stack as meaning not in a syscall, returning success with cleared output and a negative one number sentinel.
Remote observation uses a fast path for the current task and otherwise requires a non zero once read state plus matching quiescent waits around collection, else reports retryable failure.

Conversion self tests pair success tables of text plus base plus expected value with failure tables of text plus base, walking each table from start to finish and warning with continuation on any unexpected status or value.

Integer conversion checks exercise acceptance at type extremes from eight to sixty four bit signed and unsigned widths and rejection for overflow, negative input to unsigned targets, misplaced signs, illegal digits, empty input and trailing characters after newline.

Fixed point decimal checks cover integer only and fraction only forms, exact digit handling, zero padding when fraction is short, truncation when fraction is long, plus sign, trailing newline, scale progression and saturation at the unsigned sixty four bit maximum.
Access to the global selection uses single tear free loads and stores without mutual exclusion and explicitly tolerates races between readers and writers.
Remote sampling achieves stability without holding target locks across register capture by bracketing capture with inactive waits and requiring identical progress counts before and after.
Failure cases store input text with numeric base while success cases extend that pair with a typed expected result, both held in read only init time tables.
Sampled syscall output as observed carries a top level stack address plus a nested group holding number, instruction location and six ordered argument slots.

Control descriptor usage involves a name, data pointer, length limit, access mode and handler callback, allowing a temporary buffer substitution in a local copy while the original global pointer travels separately.

Control service proceeds through sizing, allocation, descriptor preparation and an exclusive direction branch toward either parse and publish or snapshot and render, each completed by generic string transfer.
Report service resolves an effective mask from caller input or global default and then fans out independently to each enabled reporter without ordering dependencies among them.
Sampling moves from self identity shortcut to state snapshot to first quiescence to register capture to second quiescence validation, aborting to retryable error on any instability along the way.
Each self test iterates its whole table, invoking the converter per entry and comparing both status and value against expectation, logging a warning and advancing on mismatch.
Exhaustion during scratch allocation aborts control handling with an out of memory status before direction logic runs, leaving the global unchanged.
Any failure from generic string transfer on the write path prevents parsing and publication and propagates directly to the caller.
Rendered name lists are length bounded and may truncate when many selections are active, and concurrent publication may cause a reader to observe either the old or new selection.
Remote capture signals retryable failure when the target lacks stable state, cannot be quiesced, loses its register view, or shows activity across capture, obliging the caller to retry.
Self test deviations only warn and continue, so overall execution still covers later entries and failures are visible only through logs rather than a propagated error.
Control hierarchy places leaf kernel_sys_info under directory kernel with owner writable and world readable permissions.
No active syscall is encoded as negative one in the number field with all other output cleared and success status, while transient instability is encoded as negative EAGAIN.
Selection state is an unsigned long bitmask with distinct bits for tasks, memory, timers, locks, trace, all CPU backtrace and blocked tasks, where zero input means use the stored default.
Scratch allocation failure is encoded as negative ENOMEM from the shared control handler.
